    WHEN lap_count <= 10 THEN '6-10'

    WHEN lap_count <= 30 THEN '21-30'

    WHEN lap_range = '6-10' THEN 2
    WHEN lap_range = '11-20' THEN 3
    WHEN lap_range = '21-30' THEN 4

SELECT 
  lt.wheel_unit,
  lt.rc_index,
  COUNT(*) as num_laps,
  ROUND(AVG(lt.msec_val / 1000.0)::numeric, 4) as avg_lap_seconds,
  ROUND(STDDEV(lt.msec_val / 1000.0)::numeric, 4) as ltc_seconds
FROM lap_times lt
GROUP BY lt.wheel_unit, lt.rc_index
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY ltc_seconds ASC
LIMIT 10;
